scope: Partial authenticated Actions reference inspection; not a complete audit
method: Read-only live workflow summary and run-options menu, transient visual inspection; no production workflow actions or artifact downloads/deletions. No screenshot files retained.
observed_reference_controls: Workflow run sidebar with status filtering, job links, Usage and Workflow file
Dependency graph with fit/zoom controls and job summaries
Annotations, artifact name/size/digest/download controls and run-options menu
Mobile Summary dropdown replacing the desktop sidebar

source_gaps.finding: The UI lists one ci.yml workflow and renders flat job sections with a single run-level log; run graph, sidebar, usage, file, summaries, annotations and artifacts are not reproduced.
The native workflow fixture is also single-workflow; artifact download returns metadata instead of a real archive.
Projects is a fixed owner-level Roadmap with table/board cards and Status edits. Multi-project lifecycle, saved views, richer fields and insights need backing state and UI.
